platform_limit: Windows 10 itself was not executed. Windows 11 Pro build26300 and Windows Server2025 are recorded separately.
presentation: Original ASCII wordmark, numbered input/engine/process/result sections, adaptive light/dark colours, plain NO_COLOR/redirected output, actual progress/counts and complete Unicode output/report paths. Interactive BAT pauses; redirected runs finish unattended.
scope: Synthetic media only. No owner testing, system ImageMagick installation changes or live website deployment. This script only reads existing evidence and public APIs.
